definitions.explanation: The powerful nations of the world, especially in a historical context referring to the dominant imperial or military powers.

examples.japanese: {列強|れっきょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦アジア→アジア：01763_ajia⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{進出|しんしゅつ}→進出：14387_shinshutsu⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The great powers advanced into Asia.

examples.japanese: ⟦{日本|にほん}→日本：03876_nihon⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{明治|めいじ}{時代|じだい}→明治時代：28080_meijijidai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧{列強|れっきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{仲間入|なかまい}り→仲間入り：07323_nakamairi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{果|は}たした→果たす：10060_hatasu⟧。
examples.english: Japan joined the ranks of the great powers during the Meiji era.

examples.japanese: 19⟦{世紀|せいき}→世紀：03373_seiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{列強|れっきょう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{植民地|しょくみんち}→植民地：16073_shokuminchi⟧⟦{獲得|かくとく}→獲得：05624_kakutoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{競|きそ}い{合|あ}った→競い合う：04656_kisoiau⟧。
examples.english: The great powers of the 19th century competed with each other to acquire colonies.

notes:
Primarily a historical term referring to the dominant world powers, especially during the 19th and early 20th centuries (Britain, France, Germany, Russia, the United States, etc.). Can also be used in modern contexts to refer to powerful nations.

Literally means "row of strong ones" (⟦{列|れつ}→列：02171_retsu⟧ = row + {強|きょう} = strong).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {列強|れっきょう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{一|ひと}つ→一つ：02948_hitotsu⟧ (one of the great powers)
- {列強|れっきょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{並|なら}ぶ→並ぶ：00605_narabu⟧ (stand alongside the great powers)
- ⟦{欧米|おうべい}→欧米：04112_oubei⟧{列強|れっきょう} (Western great powers)
